name: eca-ecommerce-agent
description: Ecommerce Academy skills bundle — brand intelligence, hero product analysis, email marketing campaigns, competitor analysis, Meta ad copywriting, customer persona building, SEO and AI blog writing, UGC video scripts, store visibility audits, Meta ads analysis (4PI), the ECA Reel Editor (a raw talking-head clip → an on-brand reel or video ad with product, review and offer cards from your store), and post-purchase surveys from writing the questions to turning the answers into angles, objections and personas. New skills are added here over time; installing this one plugin keeps you current with all of them.  What's new (v1.17.5): the Reel Editor follows the EcomOS reel templates (Founder Explainer, Founder Story, Problem → Solution, 3 Reasons, Us vs Them, Regret Review, Comment Reply) — pick one on EcomOS → Marketing Apps → Reel Editor, answer a few questions, get a brief and a script, upload the clip, and Claude edits to that brief.
